title: Under the DEC-161 frozen 0.12.0 global, lore check exits 7 here (10 schema-drift + 1 schema-unattributable) -- expected, not breakage
description:
Recorded per opum-doc ruling 2026-10-07 about 21:59Z, so the next session does not read the failure as a fault.

The workstation global lore and quest STAY at 0.12.0. They were moved to 0.13.0 at 21:54Z and rolled back at 21:56Z because nine unmoved repositories schema-drift under lore 0.13.0. The global moves LAST, after a per-repository pin move parked behind DEC-161 (opum-agent OPAG-1258).

CONSEQUENCE HERE, measured. This repository already moved to lore 0.13.0: lore-check.yml pins @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 and its committed .lore schemas are 0.13.0-generated. So running `lore check` under the BARE global 0.12.0 exits 7 -- 10 schema-drift plus 1 schema-unattributable -- because lore 0.12.0 compares the committed 0.13.0 schemas against what 0.12.0 generates. That is EXPECTED under the frozen global, not breakage here. Exit 7 is lore meaning "indeterminate: a schema it cannot attribute".

WHAT TO DO INSTEAD. Run local checks through npx with BOTH the 0.13.0 lore AND the 0.13.0 quest, because lore 0.13.0 pair-locks to its own quest version while the global quest is 0.12.0:

    npx --yes -p @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 -p @opum-ai/quest@0.13.0 lore check

Measured exit 0 in this checkout on 2026-10-07 about 22:25Z: 65 files, 0 errors, 4 warnings, 5 out-of-bundle links skipped. The single-package form `npx @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 check` ALONE exits 6, because lore 0.13.0 refuses the global quest 0.12.0 on the pair lock (corrected here from an earlier version of this record that named the single-package form). The CI job is unaffected -- it installs the pinned 0.13.0 lore and runs this checkout own 0.13.0 quest. The exit 7 clears by itself once the global moves to 0.13.0.

This task carries that expectation; close it when the global lore/quest move to 0.13.0 (after DEC-161) and `lore check` runs clean under the bare global.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The record states that lore check under the bare global lore 0.12.0 exits 7 here with 10 schema-drift plus 1 schema-unattributable, and that this is expected under the DEC-161 freeze rather than a fault.
The record names the working alternative (npx @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 for local checks, CI unaffected) and the condition that closes it (the global moving to 0.13.0 after DEC-161).

implementationNotes: INDEPENDENTLY MEASURED, 2026-10-07. With the bare globals (lore --version 0.12.0, quest --version 0.12.0), `lore check` in this checkout exits 7, and its summary line reads "65 files, 11 errors, 4 warnings, 5 out-of-bundle links skipped" -- the 11 being 10 schema-drift plus 1 schema-unattributable (grep counts on the same output). So the ruling and this record agree with a direct read, not only with the report.

RECIPE CORRECTED, 2026-10-07 about 22:25Z. The first version of this record prescribed `npx @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 check`, which ALONE exits 6 here: lore 0.13.0 pair-locks to its own quest version and the global quest is 0.12.0. The working form, measured exit 0 in this checkout, names both packages:

    npx --yes -p @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 -p @opum-ai/quest@0.13.0 lore check

Output tail: "65 files, 0 errors, 4 warnings, 5 out-of-bundle links skipped". The description above now carries this form.
